name: jev-cost-guard
description: Token-economy guard: jev decision-model MCP tools (jev_health, jev_summarize, jev_find, jev_screen), the jev-* skills, and a PostToolUse soft gate.

typesafe_api_key.title: TypeSafe API key (optional)
typesafe_api_key.description: TypeSafe direct key. When set, jev calls go to api.typesafe.ai. Leave empty to use the OpenCode Zen free tier.

opencode_zen_api_key.title: OpenCode Zen API key (optional)
opencode_zen_api_key.description: OpenCode Zen bearer key for the jev models. Leave empty to run keyless with the relay's public bearer (free tier).
